scope: Read-only bounded source research; no actual attraction admissions, bulk datasets, external writes, database access, live AI calls, accounts or credentials changes.
baseline: Parent confirmed develop 3e7010c contains 608 candidate places and 189 companions; initial 603 baseline is superseded.

sources.coverage: Global; 13m Wikidata entities; potential US museum/landmark/public-art/roadside leads, including CT/DE/VT
sources.license: CC0-1.0 for links.parquet, wikidata.parquet and wikidata_locations.parquet ONLY; ODbL for openstreetmap.parquet; CC-BY-SA-4.0 for wikipedia.parquet and wikivoyage.parquet
sources.commercial_and_redistribution: CC0 structured subset permits commercial reuse and redistribution. Isolate it from ODbL and CC-BY-SA portions; preserve original provenance as a quality measure. OSM requires attribution and applicable derivative database sharing; article-text reuse requires attribution and share alike.
sources.reason: Official Wikimedia publisher and upstream CC0 policy support structured data reuse. No actual place extraction or current visitor access, parking or calendar verification performed. Tree API confirms large global files: a full download is inappropriate; use bounded range reads or direct Wikidata API for a limited shortlist.

sources.coverage: 1,619,134 claimed places in 13 cities: top ten US cities plus San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley; weak match for CT/DE/VT gaps
sources.license: Uploader card CDLA-Permissive-2.0; card acknowledges upstream Apache-2.0 as well
sources.commercial_and_redistribution: CDLA-Permissive-2.0 and Apache-2.0 allow commercial redistribution subject to original license and Apache notice obligations. Per-record upstream provenance and required notice must be recoverable.
sources.reason: Published schema collapses source_dataset to overture; unclear whether required upstream source and Foursquare NOTICE survive. Older and geographically less useful than existing primary Overture pipeline. Snapshot confidence score is not current opening verification.

sources.coverage: Nine destinations per public indexed card; attractions, reviews, photos and descriptions
sources.commercial_and_redistribution: No reuse clearance established for original Tripadvisor-derived text, reviews and photographs.
sources.reason: Public indexed card shows Tripadvisor attraction/review URLs and dynamic-media-cdn images; original metadata API returned 401. Did not authenticate, create account or bypass access controls.

sources.coverage: 1,225 origin/destination pairs, four columns; including some CT/DE/VT named waypoints; not 1,225 distinct attractions
sources.license: Database: Open Database, Contents: Copyright Original Authors (platform label)
sources.commercial_and_redistribution: No original content grant or identifiable source contract established.
sources.reason: Publisher gives only vague open-data provenance. Pairwise travel distances/times do not establish native source identities, coordinates, present visitor access, or current hours. No archive downloaded.

sources.coverage: National brewery leads from BeerMonthClub as of October 1, 2019; no current operation or current coordinate proof
sources.commercial_and_redistribution: Uploader license label and stated permission to scrape do not independently establish downstream rights in source compilation or source-site content.
sources.reason: Older scraped dataset offers no advantage over already researched Open Brewery DB primary data. No archive downloaded. Do not assume GPL label clears upstream facts or text.

sources.coverage: Global brewery directory, filter US; prior Oct16 repo research found 4,826 strict US candidates
sources.license: MIT in primary repository; copyright 2025 Open Brewery DB
sources.commercial_and_redistribution: Retain copyright and permission notice with substantial copies. Audit original data and contribution provenance at a pinned commit.
sources.reason: Primary MIT notice fetched directly. Prior repo already reconciled Kaggle mirror; avoid duplicating bulk acquisition. No new operator calendars, public arrivals or identity conflict resolution supplied by this review.

sources.coverage: Connecticut historic district polygons; neither museum entry points nor permission to enter all parcels
sources.license: CC-BY-NC-ND (ArcGIS original metadata); Data.gov specifies CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0
sources.commercial_and_redistribution: Noncommercial and no derivatives restrictions make this unsuitable as an automatic commercial app data input without separate rights clearance.
sources.reason: Original publisher licenseInfo explicitly contains NC and ND restrictions. Public government hosting does not remove them. Area boundaries do not establish visitor facilities.

sources.coverage: Vermont state parks, recreation sites and parking point layers; potential gaps in VT nature coverage
sources.license: Dataset-level terms need reconciliation: Data.gov legacy RECSITES resource says Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike; current portal policy includes a resale restriction
sources.commercial_and_redistribution: Current portal policy allows access, sharing and integration but prohibits direct non-value-added reproduction for sale. This is not blanket CC0. Confirm exact layer terms and applicable policy before distributing normalized derivatives.
sources.reason: Policy fetched directly; no layer records imported. State park general seasons often end by second Monday October, so future operating windows and gate/calendar rules need explicit per-park review.

sources.coverage: State portal; this review did not identify an attraction-specific source with a confirmed reuse grant
sources.license: No explicit commercial redistribution grant established in portal terms read
sources.commercial_and_redistribution: Public accessibility and warranty disclaimer alone do not establish data reuse rights; inspect exact dataset metadata and any originating agency restrictions.
sources.reason: Portal terms fetched. No dataset rows downloaded or admitted.

sources.data_as_of: Catalog says last updated 2017-06-02; description refers to 2019 contents; catalog checked 2026-09-10
sources.coverage: Lewis and Clark trail museums and visitor centers across 16 states from PA to OR; could improve museum and central/northern US corridor variety
sources.license: Catalog declares US public-domain label; original layer metadata still requires inspection
sources.commercial_and_redistribution: Government-origin factual fields may be reused after original source and rights are confirmed. Partner museum content/photos are not automatically covered.
sources.reason: Specific additional federal dataset discovered through search; current original metadata endpoint and actual rows not yet verified. Old source updates cannot stand for current operation. Parent already has Omaha NPS visitor center; deduplicate it.

limitations: Source rights clearance is separate from record-level identity/access/calendar validation.
Source card counts and as-of dates are publisher claims unless an original receipt verifies them.
No total national data-file download took place.
The original API receipt list records failed fetches independently; do not report failures as successful provenance.
